faqs.q: What is the difference between the balm and the crème?
faqs.a: The balm is a snowy-white, menthol-rich salve with a stronger warming-cooling action for deep joint and muscle pain. The crème uses the same proprietary formula in a lighter, non-greasy base that absorbs quickly and does not stain clothing.

faqs.q: How long can I wear the Pain Relief Patch?
faqs.a: Apply to clean, dry skin and remove after 6 hours. Use 2 to 3 patches a day at most, and do not apply to open wounds or during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
Yes. The balm, crème, liniment and Medi-Stick are made in Singapore under GMP. The patch is manufactured in Taiwan exclusively for HST Medical.
External use only. Do not use on broken skin, on children under two, or during pregnancy or breastfeeding without asking a pharmacist. Stop and seek advice if irritation occurs.

faqs.q: Which product should I take for a sore throat?
faqs.a: Start with Alievaid Herbal Drops or Ivy Leaf Drops. Both are lozenges you dissolve slowly, with loquat leaf, jie geng and luo han guo (Alievaid) or ivy leaf extract (Ivy Leaf) to soothe the throat and calm an irritating cough.

faqs.q: Is Flu Gard suitable for children?
faqs.a: Flu Gard is a traditional Chinese medicine formula in vegicaps for adults. Follow the label and ask a pharmacist for children, during pregnancy, or if symptoms last more than a few days.
Alievaid Herbal Drops carry Halal (Malaysia) certification. The certification mark is printed on each pack; the full list of certified products is being confirmed with HST Medical.

faqs.q: Can I use Sinus Clear more than once?
faqs.a: Yes. The bottom half is a refill: a few drops onto the inhaler's cotton stick restores it. Single-person use is recommended.

chunks.t: Cough, cold or flu? Matching the symptom to the remedy
chunks.x: Alievaid Herbal Drops combine loquat leaf, jie geng, luo han guo and cordyceps with a strong cooling mint. Dissolve one slowly every two to three hours (maximum eight a day, age 12 and above). Ivy Leaf Drops do the same job with ivy leaf extract.

chunks.t: Cough, cold or flu? Matching the symptom to the remedy
chunks.x: Cough Alievaid Herbal Lintus is the syrup for a productive cough. Ivy Leaf Cough Syrup comes in single-dose 10ml sachets, convenient for travel (follow the label for ages).

chunks.t: Cough, cold or flu? Matching the symptom to the remedy
chunks.x: Flu Gard is a 100 percent herbal TCM formula in vegicaps that reduces fever, eases body aches, runny nose and sneezing, relieves cough and reduces phlegm. Two to six vegicaps, three times a day after food.

chunks.t: Cough, cold or flu? Matching the symptom to the remedy
chunks.x: Sinus Clear 2-in-1 is a lipstick-sized inhaler with a refill applicator underneath: inhale for a blocked nose, dab on the temples for a headache. It is also handy for mosquito bites. Always read the label and follow directions for use. See a doctor if fever lasts more than three days or if you have difficulty breathing.

chunks.t: Cough, cold or flu? Matching the symptom to the remedy
chunks.x: A cold rarely arrives all at once. It starts as a tickle, becomes a cough, sometimes turns into a fever and often ends with a nose that will not clear. HST Medical's cough, cold and flu range follows that arc.

chunks.t: What GMP and Halal certification mean for your supplements
chunks.x: Good Manufacturing Practice is the set of rules a facility follows so that every batch is made the same way, from raw material testing to packaging. HST Medical manufactures under GMP and additionally verifies the authenticity of ingredients, tests finished products for safety and audits any third-party manufacturer.

chunks.t: What GMP and Halal certification mean for your supplements
chunks.x: Halal certification confirms that ingredients and processes meet Islamic dietary requirements, with no porcine-derived gelatine or alcohol-based carriers. Alievaid Herbal Drops carry Halal (Malaysia) certification, and vegicaps are used across much of the range.

chunks.t: What GMP and Halal certification mean for your supplements
chunks.x: GMP tells you the product is consistent and safe. Halal tells you what is inside is permissible. Together they are part of the reason pharmacies such as Guardian, Watsons and NHGP stock the range, and why we print both on the product page, not only on the pack.

chunks.t: What GMP and Halal certification mean for your supplements
chunks.x: Supplement packs carry a lot of small print. Two marks matter more than the rest: GMP and Halal.
